Note, this structure makes a lot more sense in our product.  We have GET/POST/PUT/DELETE verbs on the naked path and further descriptions of the resource in the other class.

Also, from my debugging, it appears things go off the rails around org.jboss.resteasy.reactive.server.mapping.RequestMapper  It has the candidate route available but does not add it to the the list of candidates.
Does the same thing work with `quarkus-resteasy`?
This should work according to the spec, I am looking into it.
